UPDATE fms.reservations
           SET title      = coalesce($2, title),
               purpose    = coalesce($3, purpose),
               party_size = coalesce($4, party_size),
               start_at   = coalesce($5, start_at),
               end_at     = coalesce($6, end_at),
               is_private = coalesce($7, is_private)
           WHERE id = $1
